profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I am a 2023 Computer Science B.S. grad from Georgia Tech who enjoys solving problems and working with new technology.  I have worked both in research and industry, and both inside and outside of the field of computer science.  I have both front and backend development experience, and I am comfortable with Python (+machine learning packages, ie numpy), TypeScript, Java, SQL, and more.  I also have experience working with AWS services, such as DynamoDB, Sagemaker, Redshift, and more.  I am experienced working with AI, AI models, and have experience in prompt engineering.

My most recent work includes time at Amazon with Prime Video as a software engineer.  My experience prior to that includes research in physics on soft meta-materials--such as, how origami patterns can be used to make more resilient structures--as well as research in human computer interaction (HCI), which used gloves, pedagogy, and mathematics to teach people piano via passive haptic gloves.  I also have done work in AWS as a developer on SageMaker Canvas, and more.

In terms of personal pursuits, I maintain a plethora of hobbies.  My current favorite pass-times include reading, playing instruments and listening to music, cycling, video games, language learning, and powerlifting.

If you are interested in speaking with me for any reason, please do not hesitate to connect!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
●​ Led end-to-end execution of six regional expansions, scaling service availability to thousands of international customers
 ●​ Architected full region expansion automation pipeline, cutting deployment timelines 80% and scaling future launches 
●​ Using RedShift, Athena, and S3, managed DB queries and QuickSight dashboards to provide custom data for BI analytics
 ●​ Designed and implemented multiple security improvements, preventing attacks that could compromise customers’ data 
●​ Fullstack implementation of new options for customers to use in fine-tuning their ML models
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Engineering · Software Design

positions.description:
Research with Dr. Thad Starner
Passive haptic learning tech research; designing studies and research of relevant pedagogical info, especially music pedagogy

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Working on Amazon SageMaker Canvas backend team to develop new features.
Created a fully-functional proof of concept for a new feature for Amazon SageMaker Canvas, which was used to develop and implement that same functionality.
Designed all of the backend architecture and worked with FE team to co-ordinate, plan, and implement the design.
Wrote all of the backend code, consisting of complex API calls between large backend systems.

positions.title: Private Tutor
positions.description: Tutored multiple clients of a variety of ages in mathematics, computer science, and ACT/SAT prep.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Collaborated with high level data science team to create fully automated code to time and memory profile large sections of ML and NLP pipelines used for processing paperwork.
Identified most inefficient code and offered optimization solutions which improved system speed by 50%.
Cleaned ML training data and worked closely with ML algorithms.
Developed proof-of-concept DL algorithms with TensorFlow to demonstrate the viability of converting current statistical ML models to DL models.

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description: ●​ Researched topology and soft matter physics as it relates to origami and the physical properties of metamaterials ●​ Created tessellations using softwares such as Wolfram Mathematica to simulate and calculate origami behavior ●​ Presented at the 2020 Southeast Soft Matter Virtual Symposium and later at the GT Origami Engineering Expo
